messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Computer-assisted nonlinear optimization with interval-arithmetic verification

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square has minimum triangle area exactly 1/132, achieved by placing 12 points at the vertices of a regular 12-gon of circumradius r ≈ 0.5176 (scaled so consecutive-triple triangles have area 1/132) plus a 13th point at the center, with the regular polygon centered at (1/2,1/2); this can be verified by interval-branch-and-bound on a 26-variable nonlinear program, partitioning the square into sub-boxes and using interval arithmetic to prune any region that cannot beat 1/132."}
